evidence.observation: Growth held at 750 °C setpoint after small initial overshoot; smooth monotonic cooldown to 619 °C
Flow tracks setpoints (100 then 200 sccm) within ~1 sccm
Stable ~3.06 Torr in growth, ~4.07 Torr at higher flow — consistent with no leak/blockage
Exhaust O2 stays 3–7 ppm throughout, no air ingress
'running' throughout with values updating each event
